alignments.note: The idiom נשא פנים is rendered by one English word writing neither morpheme's own lexeme, so the pair is indivisible with the verb as the deterministic anchor (rule 6); the subject pronoun and auxiliary join under rule 17, the unit discontinuous around the negative (rule 25).
The quantifier standing on the noun is itself what the *any* renders (rule 15).
One English word carries both the coordination and the negation, headed on the negative (rule 35).
Auxiliary and subject pronoun with the verb (rule 17); the verb is rendered by a light verb plus complement and heads on the complement (rule 44).
The Hiphil of רבה is rendered by a supplied light verb plus the word carrying its own lexeme; head on that word (rules 44, 56).

review_notes: The competing reading heads the *thou givest many* unit on *givest*; רבה is the multiplying, so the lexeme sits in *many* (rule 31).
